name: mode-variants
why: Every mode a recursive tree listing can carry: a regular file, an executable, a symlink whose blob holds its target, and a gitlink naming a commit this repository does not have. The gitlink also proves the listing's type column is not what the digest reads — its type is `commit`, not `blob`, and the digest takes the mode instead.
